subtitleNullable: The results of the 2024 Boston Marathon combined with two weeks of weather data.
descriptionNullable:
For more context and a detailed analysis of this data, see this blog post on [Running with Rock](https://runningwithrock.com/boston-marathon-splits-analysis/). For an explanation of what's included and the source of the data, see below.

This dataset combines two related sets of data: the results of the 2024 Boston Marathon and weather data from the athletes' zip codes.

The "Athletes" data comes from the Boston Athletic Association, and it contains the following information:
- Individual Bib Number
- Age, Age Group, and Gender
- Zip Code
- First Half Split, Second Half Split, and Overall Finish Time (in Seconds)
- Difference Between Second and First Half Splits (in Seconds and as a Percent)

Demographic information came from the detailed results, which are available for [download here](http://registration.baa.org/2024/cf/Media/iframe_ResultsSearch.cfm). The downloadable file did not complain the split data, so that was scraped from the [results list available here](https://results.baa.org/2024/).

The first half and finish were scraped and used to calculate the positive split. This data was then matched with the demographic information and combined into a single file.

The results set has been reduced to American athletes with valid zip codes. Results for international athletes and athletes without zip codes were excluded, since they could not easily be matched to the weather data described below.

The "Weather" data comes from [Open Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/).

First, the unique zip codes included in the results set were identified. All zip codes were reduced to five digits.

Open Meteo uses latitude and longitude to fetch results form its API. The pgeocode package in Python was used to determine the latitude and longitude of each zip code.

Then, the Open Meteo API was used to fetch the following weather data for the two weeks preceding the 2024 Boston Marathon:
- Daily Min Temp
- Daily Max Temp
- Daily Average Temp

The third file - BQStandards - contains the 2020 Boston Qualifying Times for each gender and age group. Qualifying times are listed in seconds.
